expected_sources.role: Newest procurement plan by document date
Latest plan (Pamir Energy Company; STEP revision 2026-11-05)
expected_sources.note: No form-feed breaks; the text is one long page. The STEP export lists only actual amounts (mostly 0.00) and dates in a single run per row.

text: Latest published procurement plan for P170132: dated 2026-11-05 (http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099110526031019911), executing agency OJSC 'Pamir Energy Company' (GBAO); original plan approved 2020-01-03, latest revision 2026-11-05; financing IDA D5040 and E4970.

It has two parts. (1) The original textual plan, which still includes reviewer comments ('Commented [DK1]...') and the 2019-2020 package list with estimates: design, supply and installation of mini-grids in GBAO (international RFB, prior review, estimate shown as about US$17.8 million), connection of target settlements in GBAO (about US$5 million) and in Barqi Tojik's area (about US$6 million), energy-efficiency piloting (US$200,000), project management consultants for PEC (US$900,000) and BT (US$500,000), and geological and seismic studies. (2) The STEP activity table, which shows the current status.

Main current packages (STEP table): construction and installation of the Sharifobod 110/35/10 kV substation in Khorog (TJ-PE-31/2025-WO-RFB, Request for Bids, Open - National, post review, under the second AF E4970) - Signed, milestones January to June 2026, completion planned around May 2027; supply of equipment and materials for the Sharifobod substation with installation supervision (TJ-PE-30/2025-GO-RFB, Request for Bids, Open - International, prior review, two-envelope) - Signed, milestones February to September 2026. Earlier packages are completed or signed: solar PV with storage mini-grids (TJ-PE-20/2022), hydropower plant equipment (TJ-PE-22/2022) and direct contracts for 8 and 5 small HPPs (TJ-PE-21/2022-WO-A and -B); several 2020 studies were cancelled and the first project management consultant contract terminated.
Timing in context: the June 2026 ISR reports substation construction started in June 2026 and the remaining hydropower mini-grids due by 30 November 2026, within the 30 June 2027 closing.

Caveat: the STEP table in this export has no estimated-amount column (actual amounts are mostly 0.00), and the textual table's figures are truncated in the text, so amounts should be checked in the PDF.

right_sources: Identifies the newest plan by document date (40137640, 2026-11-05).
grounded: Package names, methods, review types and statuses come from the plan; no amounts or dates are invented where the text does not give them.
complete: Summarizes the main current packages and their timing or status.
scoped: Says which agency's plan it is and flags that the plan mixes the 2020 textual plan with the 2026 STEP status and lacks estimated amounts.

notes: Newer plans may be disclosed; the reviewer should confirm the approximate textual-plan estimates against the PDF.
